# JayaKrishna Arts

> Original paintings and hand-painted portrait commissions by JayaKrishna Bandari, a painter and educator from Andhra Pradesh, India, with more than forty years at the easel.

## Work
- Oil paintings and portraits
- Watercolors
- Abstract paintings
- Portrait commissions painted from customers' photographs
- Pen drawing, pencil shading and modern composition
- Art teaching (25+ years, 1,500+ students)

## Recognition
- Paintings used as set art in Indian films: Aithe (2003), Super (2005), Nagavalli (2010), Kandireega (2011), Businessman (2012), Cameraman Ganga Tho Rambabu (2012)
- Honored by Mangalampalli Balamuralikrishna and S. P. Balasubrahmanyam
- Artist of the Month, Open Studio Hartford (Artists in Real Time)
